{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Include all sales records, including refunded orders
# (The contract specifies 'all sales records', so we do not filter)

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
best_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

channel_revenue, best_channel, best_revenue"}
